params.caption: 🕹️ Steam's approval backlog is forcing more indie games to delay More indie developers say they've had to push back their release dates because Valve's queue for approving new games keeps growing. The backlog is a fairly new problem, believed to be driven by a flood of low-effort AI-made games on Steam. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 19:06 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 😤 React if this annoys you · 💬 Should Valve crack down on AI slop? #Steam #IndieGames #GamingNews
